note: Indices into SD_BGM.DAT (0-56). Track names come from the creator listening to fm_tracks/track_NN.mp3; until confirmed, values are best guesses.
sfxNote: Indices into the 23 decoded SD_SE.DAT samples (fm_sfx/sfx_NNN.mp3); defaults chosen by sound profile until confirmed.
battleNote: Normal/elite fights pick a random track from battleRandomPool and keep it for battleTrackFloors floors; bosses and rest sites use their fixed tracks.
actStartNote: Track for each act's starting room (Ancient event before floor 1); -1 keeps the game's own music.
actMapNote: Track for each act's map / events / shops (the act's background music); -1 keeps the game's own.
actShopNote: Track for each act's shops; -1 uses the act's map theme.
eliteNote: Elite fights pick a weighted track for the act (the act's own elite theme most likely; earlier acts' elite themes can return). Elite themes are kept out of battleRandomPool.
act1OpeningNote: The first act1OpeningFights normal (non-elite) fights of Act 1 play act1OpeningTrack; the random battle pool takes over after that.
